title: The Guitar Room• 8 Mins to Broadway• Pool• Gym• 6+
description:
Welcome to "The Guitar Room" in West End Nashville!

This top-floor corner condo overlooks the pool and is just steps from Centennial Park & the Parthenon. Min to Broadway, Music Row, Vanderbilt, Belmont, TSU, Nissan Stadium & Bridgestone Arena, and only 15 min from BNA.

The 2BR/2BA condo features a full kitchen, in-unit laundry, sleeper sofa, and optional air mattress. 

Enjoy access to the gym, pool, grill, secure entry, and on-site restaurant. Perfect for concerts, games, and city getaways.

The space
The Guitar Room is a modern and comfortable 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo designed with convenience and relaxation in mind.

Sleeping Arrangements:
• 2 private bedrooms
• 2 full bathrooms
• Queen-size sleeper sofa
• Optional air mattress for additional guests

Inside the Condo:
• Fully equipped kitchen
• In-unit washer and dryer
• High-speed Wi-Fi
• Smart TVs in all rooms

Community Amenities:
• Swimming pool
• Fitness center
• Outdoor grill
• Secure building access
• Elevator access
• On-site restaurant located on the first floor
